lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Four distinct horizontal rows of high-luminance, circular spots extending posteriorly from the gill region toward the caudal peduncle, exhibiting a semi-regular spatial distribution.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the primary horizontal spot rows, creating a visible rectilinear grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges running horizontally along the flank, each exhibiting a sharp vertical intensity gradient with light-saturated upper edges and shadowed lower boundaries.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct V-shaped notch is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A dense cluster of high-frequency micro-spots is visible on the cephalic region anterior to the first gill slit, contrasting with the larger spot size on the lateral flank.
